description: Add an Intercom tag to a conversation, or remove it (remove:true). Name it by tagId or exact tagName (list_intercom_tags); a tagName the workspace does not have yet is created only with create:true (ask the user first). Internal to the inbox: the customer never sees tags. Read back. Free. Needs Intercom connected (Connectors > Intercom, or connect_connector).

create.description: true = create tagName if the workspace has no such tag

remove.description: true = remove the tag from the conversation; omit or false = add it

tagId.description: Intercom tag id from list_intercom_tags; use this or tagName

tagName.description: exact tag name, as an alternative to tagId

name: tag_intercom_conversation
title: Tag an Intercom conversation
